title: Image Processing Module
summary: This module provides a collection of image processors and utility functions for various models, handling common preprocessing steps like resizing, normalization, and format conversion. It supports both Torchvision (GPU-accelerated) and PIL (CPU-based) backends, along with model-specific adaptations.

nodes.description: A standalone utility function to convert PIL images to RGB format, handling transparency blending when necessary.
